question: On August 13, 2022 the 120-inch PCCP transmission main from the Lake Huron WTP failed catastrophically about half a mile west of the plant, cutting supply to much of the northern GLWA service area for weeks. Using the incident timeline, operating data, pipe history and the post-break electromagnetic inspections, determine the probable cause of the failure (was operating pressure or a surge involved?), judge whether the rest of the inspected main needs immediate replacement, and recommend what GLWA should change in the design, operation and emergency response of this main to prevent or limit a repeat.
